name: Liangkai Liu
title: Assistant Professor
fitReason: Recent Assistant Professor with a genuine remote-intern inquiry route and substantive robotics-AI systems methods. Best treated as a remote, lower-physical-confidence backup: the current papers optimize learned perception on replayed data, and older robot experiments validate power prediction rather than learned motion control.

physicalEvidence.summary: ICRA 2023 uses an actual Donkey Mecanum platform with four motors, RealSense, lidar and Jetson, including 10 m straight and 2π spin experiments. Linear, polynomial and ten-layer MLP models predict measured motor power. The three-path energy comparison is analytical; deployment of the learned regressor in a physical decision/action loop is not established. Darknet appears in the architecture but its output-to-motion execution is not verified. The 2024 RT-BEV evaluation replays nuScenes; the 2026 Context Plane study combines UAV3D frames with simulated-agent trace replay on Jetson. These are not live driving or flight. Prior Wayne State robot work does not prove TTU research hardware access.

shortVisit.summary: The complete current-linked research-interest form explicitly names remote interns, alongside PhD recruitment, and permits arbitrary current affiliations with an optional graduate transcript. It names Fall 2026 or Spring 2027, not summer 2027. No onsite internship offer or minimum duration was found. Mixed RA funding language does not independently promise remote-intern compensation. External-university master students on the roster are collaborators, not proven onsite visitors.

scoreReasons.fit: Substantive robot/vehicle perception and execution-system research rather than generic AI; current algorithms verified in full.
scoreReasons.physical: Actual older mobile-robot power trials and learned prediction, without proven learned-action deployment; limited credit, not a robot-learning execution claim.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: The explicit internship route is remote only; no onsite visit points. Separate remote score 8 records the inquiry route without adding to the onsite total.
scoreReasons.freshness: Dated September 2026 technical paper and current Fall 2026 recruitment.
